one_liner: Devin has a REST v3 API authenticated with static cog_ service-user keys or personal access tokens, plus an official Devin MCP. No general OAuth is offered, and the pages don't settle which plan includes API access.
auth_notes: Service user keys and personal access tokens use the cog_ prefix and are sent as a Bearer token. The OAuth-style authorization-code flow on the outposts partners page is allowlist-gated by Cognition and only mints outpost worker tokens, so it is not a general third-party OAuth. Legacy v1/v2 keys still work but are not recommended.
access_notes: The pricing comparison table lists "Devin API" as a row, but the text extraction doesn't show which plans include it. Free covers only a light quota for coding with agents. Cloud agents start on Pro, and the API quickstarts target Teams and Enterprise orgs with service users. The most defensible reading is that a paid plan is needed, but this is uncertain.
blocker_notes: API access probably needs a paid Teams or Enterprise plan, though the pages don't confirm this. Credentials are static and per org or user, so each customer must create a service user key. Enterprise-scope endpoints are limited to enterprise customers.
